title: New license request: LPL-1.0
body:
### How license meets inclusion principles

It is effectively the `MPL-2.0`, but with a Remote Network Interaction section inspired by the `AGPL-3.0`. It also limits your secondary license options to only the `AGPL-3.0-or-later`. Given this, I can't imagine there would be any issues with its inclusion here.

As for the license steward, it is the law firm that I hired to write the license. While the license steward is technically the law firm, in reality, it is me.

I'm happy to close this and reopen it later when the project has more standing. I will admit that I haven’t done my homework to find out what is classified as a “significant project,” but I took that to mean it isn’t a one-off project.

### License Name

Lyra Public License 1.0

### License or Exception?
